label: West Oahu Composite Squadron
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3 in (group, squadron and activity patches 3 in); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions
provenance: Official digital artwork of West Oahu Composite Squadron (PCR-HI-075), published by Hawaii Wing (hiwg.cap.gov), heraldry page (page https://hiwg.cap.gov/about/heraldry-of-our-units; file address https://hiwg.cap.gov/media/cms/WOCS_Logo_2025_0A7DD7FB7A1AD.png); fetched 2026-11-11 and kept unchanged in assets/refs/patches-official/pcr_hi_075/. Shipped as given: the PNG; the file came without transparency on a plain white ground: the white outside the emblem's own outline was made transparent (connected from the image border, white at 250 or more of 255, spreading through whitish pixels down to 215; 68581 px) and the 2501 edge pixels blended with that white were given their coverage as alpha; then trimmed to its alpha bounding box (504 x 518 px to 494 x 510 px); no redrawing, no tracing, no colour change. Charter: the page lists it under West-Oahu Composite Squadron, PCR-HI-075; the unit's own site (westoahu.cap.gov) carries the same charter; the emblem's banner reads WEST OAHU COMPOSITE SQUADRON; PCR-HI-075 is West Oahu Comp Sqdn in the builder's unit list.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The only changes are the white ground outside the outline, made transparent so the emblem sits on the garment; the empty margin, trimmed.
